title: Departments
description: The company's departments. Every staff account belongs to exactly one — that department is what a recruitment request is filed under.

empty.title: No departments yet
empty.description: Add the company's departments so staff accounts can be assigned to one. A Hiring Manager with no department cannot file a recruitment request.
